chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Hudhayfah, from his father, from Mu'adh ibn Kathir, said:

I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), 'Indeed, the people narrate that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) fasted for twenty-nine days.' He said, and Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said to me, 'By Allah, the month of Ramadan has not decreased from thirty days and thirty nights since Allah created the heavens and the earth.'
ai.seo_question: How long is the month of Ramadan according to Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him)?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) refutes the notion that Ramadan was ever shortened to twenty-nine days, asserting its consistent thirty-day duration since creation. This serves as a definitive scholarly correction to the *ikhtilaf* (disagreement) regarding the month's length, emphasizing the fixed nature of the lunar calendar in Shia jurisprudence. The statement underscores the divine constancy of the sacred months, distinguishing the unchanging reality of Ramadan from variable reports of its duration.
